reasoning_content: The webpack process (PID 1387) is still running — that's the actual dev server. I'll terminate that specific PID, not the shell's command.

action.command: kill 1387 2>/dev/null; sleep 3; ps aux | grep -i "webpack" | grep -v grep || echo "webpack dev server stopped"; curl -s -o /dev/null --max-time 5 -w "port8080:%{http_code}\n" http://localhost:8080/ 2>/dev/null || echo "port 8080 closed (server stopped)"

tool_call.name: terminal
tool_call.arguments: {"command": "kill 1387 2>/dev/null; sleep 3; ps aux | grep -i \"webpack\" | grep -v grep || echo \"webpack dev server stopped\"; curl -s -o /dev/null --max-time 5 -w \"port8080:%{http_code}\\n\" http://localhost:8080/ 2>/dev/null || echo \"port 8080 closed (server stopped)\"", "summary": "Stop webpack dev server by PID", "security_risk": "MEDIUM"}

summary: Stop webpack dev server by PID
